About
\n

BUILDING MORE VALUABLE BUSINESSES AT THE INTERSECTION OF HOSPITALITY, WELLNESS AND REAL ESTATE.

\n

15+ years of international leadership. Premium hospitality, fitness, private membership and integrated lifestyle destinations.

\n

My career has been built across some of the world's most recognised hospitality, fitness and lifestyle brands, including Equinox, Life Time, lululemon, Four Seasons, Montage, Pendry, alongside emerging private members' clubs and integrated wellness destinations.

\n

I've led complex, multi-site operations, managed teams of more than 500 people and held responsibility for businesses with annual P&L's of up to $50 million. My experience spans commercial growth, operational transformation, membership strategy, service excellence, partnerships and the development of high-performing teams.

\n

My entrepreneurial journey began in the UK, where I founded and developed a personal training business into a holistic health club, gaining firsthand experience in business development, commercial operations and the integration of fitness and wellbeing.

\n

From luxury hospitality in the United Kingdom and Hawai\u02bbi to regional leadership in the United States, Working across established global brands and emerging lifestyle concepts has given me a distinctive understanding of how to translate ambitious visions into commercially viable businesses, aligning brand positioning, operational strategy, membership growth and exceptional customer experiences to create sustainable long-term value.

\n

My academic background adds another dimension. Having helped co-create a Clinical and Counselling Psychology Masters program at Columbia University's Teachers College, I bring expertise in human behaviour, organisational psychology and wellbeing to the commercial environments I help shape. This perspective informs my approach to leadership, organisational culture and human potential with measurable business performance.

\n

Livewells Advisory brings these disciplines together.

\n

I work with owners, developers, investors and operators to identify opportunities beyond traditional business models, connecting hospitality, wellness, workspace, residential living, education and community to create more distinctive experiences, stronger operating businesses and sustainable commercial value.

\n

People don't live in categories.
Neither should businesses.
